properties.name: Zerstörungsfreie Prüfung (ZfP / NDT)
properties.scope_note: Non-destructive testing for hidden defects, cracks, weld quality, residual thickness, concrete uniformity. ISO 9712 personnel, ISO 17635 weld NDT, EN 12504-2 rebound concrete.

properties.name: Zerstörende Prüfung (Sammelkategorie)
properties.scope_note: Parent category for destructive testing methods (cores, coupons, samples). EN 12504-1, EN 13791, EN 408, EN 14081 family.

properties.name: Korrosionsprüfung / Restdickenmessung
properties.scope_note: Corrosion assessment + residual section measurement. ISO 12944 corrosion protection of steel.

properties.name: Festigkeitssortierung Holz (visuell + maschinell)
properties.scope_note: Strength grading of structural timber per EN 14081-1 + national visual grading (DIN 4074, BS 4978).

properties.name: Beton-Bohrkernprüfung
properties.scope_note: Core drilling and compression testing of concrete elements per EN 12504-1; in-situ strength assessment per EN 13791.

properties.name: Dokumentenprüfung / Herkunfts- und Bestandsnachweis
properties.scope_note: Document review: plans, calculations, maintenance/use records, prior investigations, declared performance. Typically the first verification step before testing.

properties.name: Schadstoffprüfung (Sammelkategorie)
properties.scope_note: Parent category for pollutant/hazardous-substance testing. GefStoffV, TRGS 519/524.

properties.name: Materialprobe / Beprobung (Sammelkategorie)
properties.scope_note: Parent category for sampling: cores, coupons, swabs. TRGS 519/524 + EN 12504-1 (concrete) + DIN 18945-18947 (earth).

properties.name: Feuchteprüfung
properties.scope_note: Moisture testing for timber, earthen materials, insulation, masonry. EN 13183 series + DIN 68800.

properties.name: Brandschutznachweis (Sammelkategorie)
properties.scope_note: Generic fire-resistance proof. EN 13501-2 + EN 1995-1-2 (timber charring) + DIN 4102 + project-specific fire-engineering proofs.

properties.source: Bohrkernprüfung is a destructive testing method

properties.name: Bolzenverbindung
properties.scope_note: Reversible structural bolt connection. K.118 external steel staircase + Zinneke plywood furniture.

properties.name: Demontierbarer Schwerlastanker
properties.scope_note: Demountable heavy-duty anchor for precast concrete / reused panels. Plattenpalast Berlin GDR-precast reuse.

properties.name: Stahlverbinder für Holz (Reparatur-/Anschluss-Verbindung)
properties.scope_note: Steel connector replacing damaged glulam end / providing repair connection. Recypark Anderlecht glulam half-arches.

properties.name: Stahlrahmen für Fassadenmodul
properties.scope_note: Steel frame holding brick / masonry modules as façade panels. Resource Rows Copenhagen.
